title: Plasmon manipulation by exchange magnetic field in two-dimensional spin-orbit coupled electronic systems: A higher-order relativistic k.p study
summary: A higher-order relativistic k.p model is developed to describe plasmon excitations in two-dimensional (2D) electronic systems with spin-orbit coupling (SOC) and magnetic-exchange interactions. Derived entirely from ab initio band structure, the model allows for a non-Rashba spin-momentum locking and enables a direct coupling of the exchange field to the real spin of electrons.
